profile.headline: Applied AI Engineer & Technical Leader | Agentic Systems, Forward-Deployed Delivery & Developer Infrastructure
profile.summary:
I build difficult software—and the systems that help teams build it well.
I'm a senior hands-on software engineer and technical leader. I turn ambiguous product and platform problems into dependable systems, working from architecture through implementation, testing, release, and operations.
My current focus is disciplined agent-assisted development: clear specifications, bounded parallel work, durable decisions, evidence gates, and human review. I use agents as part of an engineering system—not as a substitute for technical judgment.
Through QualityCode, I deliver production application, cloud, data, integration, modernization, security-remediation, and reliability work for long-running client engagements. I keep client identities and proprietary implementation details confidential.
I also build public developer infrastructure. PortReeve is a local authority for stable, conflict-free ports across concurrent projects, worktrees, agents, and containers.
Earlier, I led the FileThis integration at MX, co-founded and served as CTO of FileThis, and built product software and developer systems at Adobe and other companies. Across those roles, I've remained close to the code while leading teams, shaping architecture, and improving how software gets delivered.
I'm open to senior hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and selected consulting conversations—especially where architecture, delivery discipline, and AI-assisted development meet.
Selected work: https://qualitycode.io/

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer & Technical Lead
positions.description:
Independent product, platform, and cloud engineering for long-running client engagements, combined with development of a disciplined agent-assisted delivery practice.
• Deliver production reliability, cloud and data infrastructure, integrations, migrations, security remediation, testing, and application modernization.
• Work hands-on across architecture, specifications, project decomposition, implementation, pull-request review, release, and operations.
• Build with AWS, infrastructure as code, event and data pipelines, authentication, ETL, webhooks, search and analytics, and modern Python and JavaScript systems.
• Use governed multi-agent workflows with explicit authority, durable context, evidence gates, and human review.
• Build public developer infrastructure, including PortReeve, for safe concurrent agent development.
Client identities and proprietary implementation details remain confidential.
Selected work: https://qualitycode.io/
PortReeve: https://github.com/TrentBrown/portreeve
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Blockchain · Node.js · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Vue.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Led the FileThis integration into MX while remaining hands-on in production code and client support.
• Partnered with product to define and ship a tax-document aggregation product.
• Built a mobile-friendly, embeddable web-component workflow for connecting financial institutions and retrieving documents.
• Produced SOC 2 Type 1 control evidence and implemented remediation across security, privacy, and confidentiality criteria.
• Managed delivery and provided technical, operational, and training support to API clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Linux · Web Components · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SOC 2

company.name: MX TECHNOLOGIES, INC DBA MONEY DESK TOP

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer & Cofounder
positions.description:
Co-founded FileThis and served as hands-on CTO for a cloud platform that automatically retrieved and organized consumer financial documents.
• Designed the system architecture and selected technologies around stable open-source components, cloud operation, and reduced lock-in.
• Built across backend services, persistence, data schemas, cloud provisioning, deployments, web and mobile clients, integrations, and the company website.
• Integrated payment, storage, email, analytics, and webhook-based external services.
• Established an iterative development process, built and led the engineering team, and continued shipping production code.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Elastic Load Balancing · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Docker · Spring Boot · Nginx · Amazon S3 · Amazon ECS · System Architecture · DevOps · Startup Leader

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Corte Madera, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Developed a Flex-based web client that allowed users to upload video assets, organize them in groups, manage ad campaigns, and control transcoding for different player and mobile device screen sizes.

Contributed to the development of the second major release of the company's MediaScript video transcoding software using the FFMPEG open source library.

Implemented a comprehensive CI/CD pipeline to build, test, and deploy all components of the company's services, including provisioning VM's on Xen hypervisors.

Established monitoring of production systems using Nagios, resulting in quick incident response times and excellent uptime.

Co-inventor on three US patents related to the caching of media assets: 8,495,242, 8,656,046, 8,381,110
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Video Transcoding · JavaScript Libraries · C++ · System Monitoring · DevOps

company.name: Automated Media Processing Solutions, Inc. dba Equilibrium

positions.title: Senior Computer Scientist
positions.locationName: Santa Rosa, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Designed and implemented contact management and other features of Adobe's Photoshop Express online photo sharing service using Flex, their Flash UI component library.

Created an abuse report management application based on Adobe AIR that was used internally to quarantine illegal images onto a server accessible only to the company legal team and law enforcement authorities.

Built the photo gallery authoring module for Adobe's Photoshop Elements product using the Qt cross-platform framework. Designed schema for XML �les that drive the player, customizing its appearance and behavior.
positions.insights: Skills: Qt · C++ · Adobe Flash · Application Development
